factual_claims.source_evidence: Managing Director's Statement: 'In 2025, Coop Pank... distributed 25% of its 2024 pre-tax profit as dividends... paid out €0.07 per share, transferring a total of €7.2 million in dividends to shareholders.'

numerical_claims.claim: Net profit of 28.7 million euros in 2025, 32.2 million euros in 2024, representing an 11% decrease.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Profit or Loss and Other Comprehensive Income table

numerical_claims.claim: Net interest income fell to 73.3 million euros from 77.6 million euros.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Profit or Loss table

numerical_claims.claim: Total net operating income decreased to 79.4 million euros from 81.9 million euros; net fee and commission income increased to 4.5 million euros from 4.3 million euros.
numerical_claims.candidate_value: 79.4 million EUR (2025), 81.9 million EUR (2024); 4.5 million EUR (2025), 4.3 million EUR (2024)
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: 79.4 million EUR (2025), 81.9 million EUR (2024); 4.5 million EUR (2025), 4.3 million EUR (2024)
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Profit or Loss table

numerical_claims.claim: Operating expenses rose to 41.5 million euros from 40.6 million euros; cost-to-income ratio deteriorated to 52.3% from 49.6%.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Profit or Loss table and Ratios table

numerical_claims.claim: Credit loss allowances decreased to 3.3 million euros from 4.6 million euros; income tax expense increased to 5.8 million euros from 4.5 million euros.

numerical_claims.label: CORRECT

numerical_claims.claim: Loan portfolio grew by 19% to 2.11 billion euros.

evaluation.coverage_note: All candidate sentences containing explicit numerical propositions have been covered in numerical_claims. Identifiers like 'Phase 1' or 'Stage 2' were not treated as numerical claims as they represent ordinal labels rather than quantitative propositions.
